title: KoolKisaan chamber telemetry (one message every 5 minutes)
description: MQTT topic coldtrust/{chamberId}/telemetry (QoS 1, TLS 8883, X.509 device certificate). The same values become the payload of a READING block. Simulator: tools/mqtt_simulator.py.

step.description: 5-minute step number (gaps are detected from ts)

N1.description: supply air at the coil outlet

Q_door_W.description: leakage from the ASHRAE infiltration formula

P_el_W.description: compressor + coil fan electrical power (energy meter)

ctl.description: controller log used by the physics check: P_fan_kW, cop, Q_wax_branch_kW, Q_int_kW, G_wax_kW_K, T_pcm, load_event
